conversation.content:
"Hi Anand, welcome!  It's great to finally meet you. Thanks for taking the time to interview today.  I've reviewed your resume and I'm impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based Digital Mall system and the GameZork platform.  It shows a nice range of skills.

To get started, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself, your background, and what interests you most in this type of role?"

Anand, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today.  I’ve truly appreciated learning more about your experience and skills; you’ve provided us with some valuable insights.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we will be in touch regarding the next steps in the hiring process within [Number] business days.  Thank you again for your interest in [Company Name].  We wish you all the best.
